title: Yeka Sub-City Moving Overview: Megenagna to Meri
excerpt: Yeka from Megenagna and Shola to Kotebe and Meri: school corridors, hillside carries, condo handovers, and how eastern Addis quotes differ by neighborhood.
content:
Yeka on the map

Yeka sub-city covers eastern Addis—from Megenagna and Shola toward Kotebe, Meri, and Entoto foothills. One sub-city name hides very different access: a Megenagna tower move is elevator logistics; a Meri hillside villa may be stairs-only from a narrow lane. Quotes need both compound names and a recent route check.

Major corridors

  • Shola–Megenagna: school traffic and junction staging—see our corridor guide.
  • Kotebe: newer blocks and long internal drives—Kotebe guide.
  • Summit / Fiyel Bet edge: gated rules and Ayat-bound traffic—Summit guide.

School zones and timing

Yeka schools compress traffic 7:30–9:00 and 14:00–16:00 on weekdays. Schedule load-out after morning rush or use Saturday slots when management allows weekend freight. End-of-month handovers stack in Shola and Megenagna towers—book elevator hours in the first week you know your move date.

Hills and heavy items

Steep segments toward Entoto and some Meri compounds increase crew size and time. Pianos, safes, and large wardrobes need a survey that notes slope and gate width—not just bedroom count. Compare hourly vs fixed pricing when carry distance is long.

Condo and handover

Use the condo checklist for meter photos, lift deposits, and management permits. Align move-out cleaning with renter handover so keys and elevator time do not conflict.

Pricing and booking

Typical starting tiers for Addis homes are on our 2026 cost guide. Neighbors in the same tower can share mobilization—group move tips.

Meri and hillside access

Meri and upper Yeka streets may require smaller trucks for final approach, with goods transferred from a staging vehicle. That pattern adds labor but prevents day-of cancellations when a large truck cannot turn. Survey photos of gate width and slope save disputes. Rain on Entoto-facing slopes slows trolleys—pack indoors the day before when possible.

Entoto edge and Gullele links

Moves touching Entoto foothills or upper Gullele share hillside discipline with our Gullele & Entoto guide. Heavy items need extra crew—not a smaller quote because the address still says Yeka.
